moveRule: Drop it into an empty socket.
pullRule: Tug the middle for a springy rebound.
DocksRule: Fill every colored socket with a matching peg. Then clear the crossings.
WallRule: A red cord means the drop would cross the wall. Try a socket around either end.
FixedRule: Screwed-down pegs stay put. Move their other ends.
ReachRule: Gold bands mark a short cord. Move its other end closer to reach a far socket.
GuideRule: This cord always runs through its ring. Move either end to change its route.
RailRule: The striped peg slides between the two ends of its track.
TensionRule: Silver bands mark a stiff cord. Keep its pegs apart.
boardAccess: Cord board. Use the arrow keys to select a socket, Space to pick up or drop a peg, and Escape to release it.
